findings: Compared the v7.4.1 README against the audited v7.4.0 body and the working candidate. STEP3 now derives Camera from STEP2 in 5–8-panel layout, restores source staging for a conflicting reply and records rejected layout evidence. Dialogue mapping, geometry, media, image models and retry boundaries remain unchanged. The version, changelog, FAQ, and candidate ZIP URL are synchronized. The existing custom-node ZIP hash is unchanged. Other README sections inherit the unchanged v7.4.0 behavior and the previous section review.
manualFindings: Rebuilt and rendered 71 pages across the three v7.4.1 PDFs. Compared every page body to the previous local reviewed set; only Gemini p1 and system p18/p19 changed above the footer. Visually inspected these pages, the current diagnostic page 32 and the OpenAI guide cover; no overlap, missing glyphs or clipping. Checked all page footers, bounds, links and privacy text using the existing PDF verifier.
